summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）With another sequel in the making, monkeypox virus (MPXV) has yet again resurfaced in the African subcontinent and in several non-endemic countries, prompting the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare monkeypox (Mpox) a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). title: Autoantibodies neutralizing type I IFNs in a fatal case of H5N1 avian influenza.
headline_zh: Autoantibodies neutralizing type I IFNs in a fatal case of H5N1 avian influenza.
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）Avian influenza A virus (IAV) H5N1 is an emerging threat of human pandemic. We describe a 71-year-old man who died of H5N1 pneumonia in Louisiana and whose blood contained autoantibodies neutralizing type I IFNs (AAN-I-IFNs), including the 12 IFN-α subtypes (1-10 ng/ml) and IFN-ω (100 pg/ml). Causality between these AAN-I-IFN and lethal outcome of avian influenza in this patient is based on (1) our previous report that AA-I-IFN underlie about 5% of cases of critical pneumonia triggered by seasonal influenza viruses in three cohorts, (2) the rarity of this combination of AAN-I-FNs in individuals over 70 years old (<1%), and (3) the rarity of lethal avian influenza among infected individuals (<1%).

headline_zh: The toll of voting in a pandemic? Regional elections and the spread of COVID-19 in…
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）This study investigates whether the regional elections held in the German state of Bavaria on March 15 of 2020 - shortly after the WHO declared COVID-19 a global pandemic - contributed to the spread of COVID-19 cases and COVID-related deaths. title: First detection and characterization of a non-haemadsorbing African swine fever virus (genotype II) isolated from a wild boar in Russia.

summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）Smallholder livestock farming underpins food security and rural livelihoods in Lao PDR, yet the sector is threatened by endemic infectious diseases such as foot and mouth disease (FMD). title: The detection paradox: How COVID-19 surveillance patterns shifted from lower-income to more affluent neighborhoods in Miami-Dade County.
headline_zh: The detection paradox: How COVID-19 surveillance patterns shifted from lower-income to…
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）Passive disease surveillance systems may systematically undercount burden in low-resource minority neighborhoods, yet fine-scale evidence of this phenomenon remains limited. We examined spatiotemporal patterns of reported COVID-19 cases across Miami-Dade County's diverse neighborhoods and investigated which socioeconomic and demographic characteristics predicted areas of elevated and suppressed case rates. In an ecological, cross-sectional analysis of 491,769 geocoded cases across 1,831 census block groups from March 2020 to May 2021, we applied negative binomial regression with spatial eigenvector filtering and Getis-Ord Gi* hot spot analysis across five pandemic periods aligned with major policy shifts.

title: Rising spillover risk: Lessons from the Andes hantavirus outbreak.
headline_zh: Rising spillover risk: Lessons from the Andes hantavirus outbreak.
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）The unprecedented expansion of human activity boundaries is turning spillover from a chance event into a foreseeable ecological and epidemiological certainty. Using the 2026 Andes hantavirus cruise ship outbreak as an entry point, this study examines it within a broader driver framework: nearly all emerging infectious disease events in humans in recent decades have originated from wildlife transmission; under climate-change and land-use scenarios, approximately 3139 mammal species are projected to aggregate in new combinations by 2070, causing an estimated 4000 cross-species viral transmission events. The rapid expansion of tourism into ecologically fragile regions - sub-Antarctic waters, the deep sea, and primary forests - the persistence of habitat fragmentation and animal trade, and the reshaping of wildlife distribution and vector dynamics by extreme climate events together constitute "novel contact amplifiers" that accelerate contact at the human-animal-environment interface.

headline_zh: Epidemiological Characteristics of Pertussis in Hainan Province, 2023-2025.
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）OBJECTIVE: To analyze the epidemiological characteristics of pertussis in Hainan Province from 2023 to 2025, describe the outbreak trajectory and patterns of population susceptibility, and provide evidence for optimizing pertussis prevention and control strategies. METHODS: Clinically diagnosed and confirmed pertussis cases reported in Hainan Province between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2025, were retrieved from the China Information System for Disease Control and Prevention; suspected cases were excluded, yielding a total of 2,927 eligible cases.Descriptive epidemiological methods were used to analyze the temporal, geographic, and population distributions of the cases; piecewise linear regression was employed to characterize monthly trends in case counts; and multivariable logistic regression was performed to identify risk factors for hospitalization. summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）Recently, Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 virus has been widely prevalent globally. title: [Securitisation of health and the production of neglect: the case of the United Nations Mission for Ebola Emergency Response (2014-2015)].
headline_zh: [Securitisation of health and the production of neglect: the case of the United Nations…
summary_zh: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）This study aims to analyze the international community's response to the health crisis caused by the Ebola virus outbreak in West Africa (2014-2015), addressed through the establishment of the United Nations Mission for Ebola Emergency Response (UNMEER). This unprecedented mission resulted from a process of securitisation of Ebola by the United Nations, in that it transformed the response to the disease into a form of threat containment through immediate medical care, rather than addressing the socioeconomic factors related to the emergence and recurrence of the illness. Through a narrative literature review on the securitisation of health within Critical Security Studies, as well as documentary research on the international response to Ebola, this research concludes that the securitisation of the disease resulted in neglectful outcomes in the international community's response to the outbreak, failing to reduce vulnerabilities faced by affected populations.
